title: Add Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as 4th Pareto Objective in GA
source: 2026 literature: MDPI NBA/WNBA study + Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (2026)

problem.current_state: GA optimizes 3 objectives: Brier, ROI, Sharpe. Two models with identical Brier=0.221 can have very different calibration quality (ECE 0.08 vs 0.02). The GA cannot distinguish them.
problem.evidence: S15 top_individual=0.21883 is nearest-ever to checkpoint. But is it well-calibrated? Without ECE tracking, we cannot know. A poorly-calibrated model at 0.218 is worse for live betting than a well-calibrated 0.220.
problem.risk: Checkpoint a poorly-calibrated model that degrades live ROI despite good Brier on walk-forward

solution.description: Add ECE (Expected Calibration Error) as a 4th fitness dimension. Use as tiebreaker when Brier scores are within 0.001 of each other. Log ECE alongside Brier in all island status endpoints.
solution.formula: ECE = sum_b(|B| / N * |accuracy(b) - confidence(b)|) over n_bins=10 calibration buckets

code: # In evaluate_individual, after: brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, y_prob)
# In /api/status, expose: best_ece = min(ind.ece for ind in population)

pareto_change.tiebreaker_rule: When two Pareto-front solutions have |brier_diff| < 0.001, prefer lower ECE
pareto_change.implementation: Modify nsga2_select() to include ece as 4th objective dimension

expected_impact.live_roi_impact: Better-calibrated probabilities → more accurate Kelly sizing → +1-2% ROI
expected_impact.breakthrough_probability: S15 at 0.21883 — ECE-guided selection may surface sub-0.21837 solution

literature.source: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting, MDPI Information 2026
literature.finding: ECE and MCE are essential metrics alongside Brier; top models achieve ECE~0.051

literature.source: Stacked ensemble NBA prediction, Scientific Reports 2025
literature.finding: Calibration errors (ECE/MCE) should be logged as primary quality gates

cross_project.note: Political Alpha currently at Brier=0.25 (PA4). ECE tracking would immediately reveal if models are systematically over/under-confident on political events. Port same compute_ece() function.

deployment_order: 1. Test on S15 (wide_search, most gens, nearest to breakthrough)
2. Roll to S14 (fleet best, extra_trees dominant)
3. Roll to remaining 4 islands after 2 cycles of validation
